parse.title: Sea God
parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 15.5 - Summer update

Overview

Sea God​ is a Secret Limited unit​. He can only be obtained via completing Sea God's Portal (guaranteed if you are the host).

Evolving

Sea God can evolve into Sea God (Tyrant of the Seas) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Sea God
x1 Sea God's Trident Sea God's Trident
x12 Star Fruit
x5 Star Fruit (Blue)
x3 Star Fruit (Pink)
x4 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
